title: マヤノトップガン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is a naturally gifted racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dreams of running in exciting races where she can "twinkle." Her journey towards the Twinkle Series starts now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I vow to help her grow into a spectacular racer.
